Finding 1

Both your live Meta ads link to a Valentino bottle, and neither links to your own Vanilla Muse

Your two live Meta ads both link to Valentino Born in Roma, where the 3.4 oz and the gift set are sold out and the in-stock sizes cost $104.98 and $129.98. Neither ad links to Vanilla Muse, which your page describes as a REBL Scents exclusive: 3 oz for $69.95, with a caramel and vanilla base, in stock.

What we saw

Ad "For the vanilla lovers" and ad "Smell like a snack all summer long", both live since 12 July, both link to the Valentino page.

Why it matters

Shoppers can price a Valentino bottle at other retailers, and discount stores advertise designer scents at up to 80% off. A scent your page calls exclusive is harder to price-shop. Whether that sells better is what the test answers.

The change

Make a Vanilla Muse version of the vanilla ad and run it beside the current one. The second ad's hashtags name Valentino, so watch the full video before reusing it: it only works for version B if it doesn't show the Valentino bottle.

Proposed paid test · not yet run

Current Valentino ad against a Vanilla Muse ad.

  1. 01Build version BVanilla Muse creative (draft below) linking to the Vanilla Muse page.
  2. 02Run A and B side by sideA is the current ad and Valentino page. Same audience, budget and dates.
  3. 03Compare purchase revenue per dollarYour margins on each decide what the result is worth; that's what the call is for.

This tests the product, the creative and the page together.

Sources: ad 1350489516423347, ad 2279714656191342, Valentino page, Vanilla Muse page, 5 Nov 2026

Finding 2

Two creator reels about your own scents got 43,625 plays; neither runs as an ad

On 25 September 2024, the day your three new scents launched, two creators posted reels about them that show on your Instagram. The median across the 42 reels in your posts since 9 September 2024 is 2,858 plays. Your two live ads are your own videos, and both link to Valentino.

Not in your live adsView the reel ↗

What we saw

Both reels are about your own scents, not designer bottles. They got 11 and 4 times that median.

Why it matters

The videos already exist and show scents your page calls REBL Scents exclusives. Whether they sell better than the current ad is what the test answers.

The change

Ask both creators for permission to run their reels as partnership ads, linking to the scents they show. Before using either, watch the whole video and check paid-use rights, the products shown and any discount codes in it. @ann.wynn names two other brands' perfumes, so check Meta's ad rules first.

Proposed paid test · not yet run

A creator reel as a partnership ad against your current Valentino ad. Same audience, budget and dates. Winner: purchase revenue per dollar spent.

Sources: @roxslayofficial reel, @ann.wynn reel, REBL's 60 newest posts, read 6 Nov 2026

Finding 3

Your most-played reel since 9 September 2024 was a December gifting reel; 11 of the first 12 sets on your Gift Sets page are sold out

Your reel of 10 December 2024 ("top designer fragrances this gifting season") has 94,807 plays, 33 times the median of your 42 reels since 9 September 2024. Second is 7 January 2025, with 73,907. Going into this holiday season, your Gift Sets page lists 89 sets and 18 are in stock.

Other things we checked

Before the kit ad runs: the standalone bottles of 3 of your 9 kit scents are sold out

Your $24.98 discovery kit holds 2 ml sprays of nine REBL scents. The standalone bottles of Drippin' Gold, Hexed and Onyx ($49.99 each) are sold out; their 10 ml travel sprays ($14.98) are in stock. Your REBL Bundle lists Hexed and Onyx pairings as "full sized", but its options are 2 ml samples (see the bundle check below), so it isn't a clear bottle route.

Sources: kit page, Drippin' Gold, Hexed, Onyx, travel sprays, 5 Nov 2026

Before adding catalog ads: 10 of your top 20 best sellers are sold out in every size

You likely know your stock. It matters for ads in one way: catalog ads pull products from your feed, so sold-out items need to be excluded from any feed you advertise from. You don't run catalog ads today, so this is a launch check.

Source: best-selling page and product records, 5 Nov 2026

Your REBL Bundle page says "full sized" but lists 2 ml samples

The description reads "Create your own two fragrance bundle with our full sized REBL Exclusives", then lists each scent as "Sample 2ml / 0.07 fl oz". Fix the size wording before the bundle goes into any ad.

Source: REBL Bundle page, 5 Nov 2026

Google's archive shows no REBL ad after 2 May 2026

Google's public archive lists 13 REBL ads (7 text, 5 image, 1 video), first seen from 20 February 2024. The latest last-shown date is 2 May 2026. The archive can't tell us whether that was a pause or a gap in its records. Worth checking against your Google Ads account: what branded searches for REBL and your scent names cost, and what they sold.

Source: Google Ads Transparency Center, US, 5 Nov 2026
